verses.t: Yahweh spoke to Moshe in the wilderness of Sinai, in the Tent of Meeting, on the first of the second month, in the second year after their going out from the land of Egypt:
“ Lift the head of the whole community of Yisrael’s sons — by their clans, by their fathers’ house, by the number of names, every male, by their skulls.
From twenty years old and up, everyone going out to the army in Yisrael — y’all shall take account of them by their armies, you and Aharon.
And with y’all there shall be a man for each tribe, each man head of his fathers’ house.
These are the names of the men who will stand with y’all: for Reuven, Elitsur son of Shedeur;
for Shimon, Shelumiel son of Tsurishaddai;
for Yehudah, Nachshon son of Amminadav;
for Yissakhar, Netanel son of Tsuar;
for Zevulun, Eliav son of Chelon;
for the sons of Yoseph: for Ephrayim, Elishama son of Ammihud; for Menasheh, Gamliel son of Pedahtsur;
for Binyamin, Avidan son of Gidoni;
for Dan, Achiezer son of Ammishaddai;
for Asher, Pagiel son of Okhran;
for Gad, Elyasaph son of Deuel;
for Naphtali, Achira son of Enan.”
These were the summoned of the community, chieftains of their fathers’ tribes; they were heads of the thousands of Yisrael.
And Moshe and Aharon took these men who had been designated by names,

and they assembled the whole community on the first of the second month, and they declared their descent by their clans, by their fathers’ house, by the number of names, from twenty years old and up, by their skulls,
as Yahweh commanded Moshe. And he took account of them in the wilderness of Sinai.

The sons of Reuven, Yisrael’s firstborn — their generations, by their clans, by their fathers’ house, by the number of names, by their skulls, every male from twenty years old and up, everyone going out to the army —
their accounted-for, for the tribe of Reuven: forty-six thousand five hundred.
These are the accounted-for whom Moshe accounted for, and Aharon, and the chieftains of Yisrael — twelve men, one man each for his fathers’ house.
And all the accounted-for of Yisrael’s sons by their fathers’ house, from twenty years old and up, everyone going out to the army in Yisrael —
all the accounted-for were six hundred three thousand five hundred fifty.
But the Levites, by their fathers’ tribe, were not accounted for among them.
Yahweh spoke to Moshe:
“Only the tribe of Levi you shall not take account of, and their head you shall not lift among Yisrael’s sons.

Rather, appoint the Levites over the Dwelling of the Testimony, over all its vessels and over all that belongs to it. They shall carry the Dwelling and all its vessels, and they shall serve it, and around the Dwelling they shall camp.
When the Dwelling sets out, the Levites shall take it down; when the Dwelling camps, the Levites shall set it up; and the stranger who comes near shall be put to death.
Yisrael’s sons shall camp each man at his camp and each man by his company, by their armies.
But the Levites shall camp around the Dwelling of the Testimony, so there is no wrath on the community of Yisrael’s sons; and the Levites shall keep the charge of the Dwelling of the Testimony.”
Yisrael’s sons did it; according to all that Yahweh commanded Moshe, so they did.
Yahweh spoke to Moshe and to Aharon, saying:
“Each man by his company, with the signs of their fathers’ house, Yisrael’s sons shall camp; facing, at a distance, all around the Tent of Meeting they shall camp.
Those camping frontward, toward the sunrise: the company of the camp of Yehudah, by their armies; and the chieftain of the sons of Yehudah, Nachshon son of Amminadav.
His army, and their accounted ones: seventy-four thousand six hundred.
And those camping next to him: the tribe of Yissakhar; and the chieftain of the sons of Yissakhar, Netanel son of Tsuar.
His army, and its accounted ones: fifty-four thousand four hundred.
The tribe of Zevulun; and the chieftain of the sons of Zevulun, Eliav son of Chelon.
His army, and its accounted ones: fifty-seven thousand four hundred.
All the accounted ones of the camp of Yehudah: one hundred eighty-six thousand four hundred, by their armies. First they shall set out.
The company of the camp of Reuven, southward, by their armies; and the chieftain of the sons of Reuven, Elitsur son of Shedeur.
All the accounted ones of the camp of Reuven: one hundred fifty-one thousand four hundred fifty, by their armies. Second they shall set out.
Then the Tent of Meeting shall set out, the camp of the Levites, in the midst of the camps. As they camp, so they shall set out, each man at his station, by their companies.
The company of the camp of Ephrayim, by their armies, seaward; and the chieftain of the sons of Ephrayim, Elishama son of Ammihud.
All the accounted ones of the camp of Ephrayim: one hundred eight thousand one hundred, by their armies. Third they shall set out.
The company of the camp of Dan, northward, by their armies; and the chieftain of the sons of Dan, Achiezer son of Ammishaddai.
All the accounted ones of the camp of Dan: one hundred fifty-seven thousand six hundred. Last they shall set out, by their companies.
These are the accounted ones of Yisrael’s sons by their fathers’ house; all the accounted ones of the camps, by their armies: six hundred three thousand five hundred fifty.
But the Levites were not accounted among Yisrael’s sons, as Yahweh commanded Moshe.
And Yisrael’s sons did according to all that Yahweh commanded Moshe: so they camped by their companies, and so they set out, each man by his clans, by his fathers’ house.
These are the generations of Aharon and Moshe, on the day Yahweh spoke with Moshe on Mount Sinai.
These are the names of Aharon's sons: the firstborn Nadav, and Avihu, Elazar and Itamar.
These are the names of Aharon's sons, the anointed priests, whose hand he filled to serve as priests.

But Nadav and Avihu died before Yahweh when they brought near strange fire before Yahweh in the wilderness of Sinai, and they had no sons. So Elazar and Itamar served as priests in the lifetime of Aharon their father.
Yahweh spoke to Moshe:
" Bring near the tribe of Levi and station it before Aharon the priest, and they will attend him.
They will keep his charge and the charge of the whole community before the Tent of Meeting, to do the work of the Dwelling.
They will keep all the equipment of the Tent of Meeting and the charge of the Israelites, to do the work of the Dwelling.
You will give the Levites to Aharon and to his sons; given, given are they to him from among the Israelites.
And Aharon and his sons you will appoint, and they will keep their priesthood; and the stranger who draws near will be put to death."
Yahweh spoke to Moshe:
"And I — look, I have taken the Levites from among the Israelites in place of every firstborn, what opens the womb among the Israelites; the Levites will be mine.
For every firstborn is mine. On the day I struck down every firstborn in the land of Egypt I set apart for myself every firstborn in Yisrael, from human to beast. Mine they will be. I am Yahweh."
Yahweh spoke to Moshe in the wilderness of Sinai:
" Take account of the sons of Levi by their ancestral houses, by their clans; every male from a month old and up you will take account of them."
So Moshe took account of them at the mouth of Yahweh, as he had been commanded.
These were the sons of Levi by their names: Gershon, Kehat and Merari.
These are the names of the sons of Gershon by their clans: Livni and Shimi.
The sons of Kehat by their clans: Amram and Yitshar, Chevron and Uzziel.
The sons of Merari by their clans: Machli and Mushi. These are the clans of the Levites by their ancestral houses.

Those camping before the Dwelling eastward, before the Tent of Meeting toward the sunrise: Moshe, and Aharon and his sons, keeping the charge of the holy place as the charge of the Israelites; and the stranger who draws near will be put to death.
All the accounted for of the Levites whom Moshe and Aharon accounted for at the mouth of Yahweh by their clans, every male from a month old and up: twenty-two thousand.
Yahweh said to Moshe: " Take account of every firstborn male of the Israelites from a month old and up, and take up the number of their names.
And take the Levites for me — I am Yahweh — in place of every firstborn among the Israelites, and the Levites' livestock in place of every firstborn among the Israelites' livestock."
So Moshe took account, as Yahweh had commanded him, of every firstborn among the Israelites.
And every firstborn male by the number of names, from a month old and up, of those accounted for among them, was twenty-two thousand two hundred and seventy-three.
Yahweh spoke to Moshe:
"Take the Levites in place of every firstborn among the Israelites, and the Levites' livestock in place of their livestock; the Levites will be mine. I am Yahweh.
As the redemption price of the two hundred and seventy-three of the Israelites' firstborn who are surplus over the Levites,
you will take five shekels apiece per skull; by the shekel of the holy place you will take it, twenty gerahs to the shekel.
And you will give the silver to Aharon and to his sons, the redemption price of the surplus among them."
So Moshe took the silver of the redemption price from those surplus over those redeemed by the Levites.
From the firstborn of the Israelites he took the silver: one thousand three hundred and sixty-five, by the shekel of the holy place.
And Moshe gave the silver of the redemption price to Aharon and to his sons at the mouth of Yahweh, as Yahweh had commanded Moshe.
Yahweh spoke to Moshe and to Aharon, saying:
Lift the head of the sons of Kehat from among the sons of Levi, by their clans, by their ancestral houses,
from thirty years old and upward to fifty years old, everyone who comes into the army to do work in the Tent of Meeting.
This is the service of the sons of Kehat in the Tent of Meeting: the most holy things.
When the camp sets out, Aharon and his sons shall come in and take down the screening curtain and cover the chest of the testimony with it.
They shall put on it a covering of tachash skin and spread a cloth wholly of blue over it, on top, and set its poles.
Over the table of the Presence they shall spread a cloth of blue, and put on it the dishes, the ladles, the bowls, and the jugs for pouring; and the continual bread shall be on it.
They shall spread over them a cloth of scarlet and cover it with a covering of tachash skin, and set its poles.
They shall take a cloth of blue and cover the lampstand of the light, and its lamps, and its tongs, and its firepans, and all its oil vessels with which they tend it.
They shall put it and all its vessels into a covering of tachash skin and put it on the carrying frame.
Over the golden altar they shall spread a cloth of blue and cover it with a covering of tachash skin, and set its poles.

They shall take all the vessels of ministry with which they minister in the holy place, and put them into a cloth of blue, and cover them with a covering of tachash skin, and put them on the carrying frame.
They shall clear the altar of its fat-ash and spread a cloth of purple over it.

They shall put on it all its vessels with which they minister on it: the firepans, the forks, the shovels, and the basins, all the vessels of the altar; and they shall spread over it a covering of tachash skin and set its poles.

When Aharon and his sons have finished covering the holy things and all the vessels of the holy place, when the camp sets out, after that the sons of Kehat shall come to carry; but they shall not touch the holy, and die. These are the burden of the sons of Kehat in the Tent of Meeting.

And the oversight of Elazar son of Aharon the priest: the oil for the light, the incense of spices, the continual grain offering, and the anointing oil — oversight of all the Dwelling and all that is in it, in the holy place and in its vessels.
Yahweh spoke to Moshe and to Aharon, saying:
Do not cut off the tribe of the clans of the Kehatite from among the Levites.
Do this for them, so that they live and do not die when they approach the most holy things: Aharon and his sons shall come in and set them, each man, to his service and to his burden.
But they shall not come in to see the holy, even for the space of a swallow, and die.
Yahweh spoke to Moshe, saying:
Lift the head of the sons of Gershon too, by their ancestral houses, by their clans.
From thirty years old and upward to fifty years old you shall account for them, everyone who comes to enlist in the army, to serve the service in the Tent of Meeting.
This is the service of the clans of the Gershonite: to serve and to carry.
They shall carry the curtains of the Dwelling and the Tent of Meeting, its covering and the covering of tachash that is on top of it, and the screen of the entrance of the Tent of Meeting,

and the hangings of the court and the screen of the entrance of the gate of the court that is around the Dwelling and the altar, and their cords and all the vessels of their service, and all that is to be done with them; so they shall serve.

At the mouth of Aharon and his sons shall be all the service of the sons of the Gershonite, for all their burden and all their service; and you shall appoint to them, as their charge, all their burden.
This is the service of the clans of the sons of the Gershonite in the Tent of Meeting, and their charge is under the hand of Itamar son of Aharon the priest.
The sons of Merari: by their clans, by their ancestral houses, you shall account for them.
From thirty years old and upward to fifty years old you shall account for them, everyone who comes into the army to serve the service of the Tent of Meeting.
And this is the charge of their burden, for all their service in the Tent of Meeting: the frames of the Dwelling and its bars and its posts and its bases,

and the posts of the court all around and their bases and their pegs and their cords, for all their vessels and for all their service; and by names you shall account for the vessels of the charge of their burden.
This is the service of the clans of the sons of Merari, for all their service in the Tent of Meeting, under the hand of Itamar son of Aharon the priest.
All those accounted for, whom Moshe and Aharon and the chieftains of Yisrael accounted for, the Levites, by their clans and by their ancestral houses,
from thirty years old and upward to fifty years old, everyone who comes to serve the service of service and the service of burden in the Tent of Meeting,
their accounted ones were eight thousand five hundred and eighty.
At the mouth of Yahweh he accounted for them by the hand of Moshe, each man over his service and over his burden; and his accounted ones, as Yahweh commanded Moshe.
